Bundled so the hub works on a Pi with no internet.

- leaflet/ : Leaflet 1.9.4 (BSD-2-Clause), from https://unpkg.com/leaflet@1.9.4/dist/
- fonts/archivo-latin-var.woff2 : Archivo variable font, latin subset, wdth 62-125, wght 400-900
  (SIL Open Font License 1.1), from Google Fonts (fonts.gstatic.com/s/archivo/v25).

Map tiles still come from OpenStreetMap, so the map background needs internet; site markers and
the site list work without it.
